args.description: top-down view of a floor: a 4 by 4 grid of 16 small square tiles of dark brown leather with thin gold tooled borders between them, every tile different: a gold corner ornament, a scuff, stitching, plain leather, a gold dot, a worn spot

front view of a seamless repeating wall texture filling the whole picture: dark brown book-cover leather with gold tooling and embossed patterns, a gilded edge along the top, no doorway, no sky, no floor, dark fantasy pixel art

front view of a flat wall surface filling the whole picture, seen straight on, no doorway, no sky, no floor: dark brown book-cover leather with gold tooling and embossed patterns, a gilded edge along the top, with a big gold embossed emblem in the middle, dark fantasy pixel art
front view of a narrow pillar of rolled leather with gold bands, dark fantasy pixel art
top-down view of a uniform seamless tileable texture of dark leather with gold stitching, no objects, no border, filling the whole picture
